documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015

analysis.summary: Bajaj Auto reported record financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, with volumes reaching 1.4 million units, revenues crossing INR17,000 crores, and PAT at INR3,000 crores. Management highlighted robust export and EV growth, alongside severe cost pressures from hyper-inflationary commodity environments and supply chain disruptions. The company is pursuing capacity expansion of almost 25% from 7 million units to 9 million units per annum and executing a massive product makeover in the domestic motorcycle segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment across both domestic and international markets, particularly in key regions, is very positive despite business volatility.
demand_outlook.quote: Having said that, the demand environment, both in domestic and international, particularly in our key markets, is very positive, though the business environment may still be a bit volatile.

capex_expansion.claim: Bajaj Auto is undertaking an expansion of manufacturing capacity by nearly 25% from the current 7 million units per annum to progressively reach 9 million units per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.

margins_costs.claim: Commodity inflation intensified during the quarter, creating a hyperinflationary environment with the overall impact reaching about 4.5% of revenue.
margins_costs.quote: Through the quarter, commodity inflation intensified even further. Inflation across the metals complex accelerated meaningfully through May, taking the overall inflationary impact for the quarter to about 4.5% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Calibrated pricing actions implemented through April and June enabled the company to offset nearly half of the commodity inflation.
margins_costs.quote: And as I had indicated in the previous call, we responded with calibrated pricing very judiciously taken through April and June, enabling us to offset nearly about half of the inflation through pricing.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter reached 20.9%, an improvement of 10 basis points sequentially.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins inched up to 20.9%, an improvement of 10 basis points sequentially despite the hyperinflationary commodity environment that I'd spoken about.

orders_capacity.claim: External supply shocks and disruptions constrained the company's ability to fully service demand, resulting in a loss of about 10% of volume production opportunities during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: While these disruptions did constrain our ability to fully service demand and resulted in some loss of production opportunities of about 10% of volume during the quarter, the business still delivered record volumes and financial performance.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated over INR2,300 crores of free cash flow during the quarter, representing a cash conversion of almost 80% of profit after tax.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated over INR2,300 crores of free cash flow during this quarter, almost double that of the same period last year, translating into a cash conversion of almost 80% of profit after tax.

capital_allocation.claim: Surplus cash on the balance sheet exceeded INR21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: The balance sheet continues to remain very healthy with surplus cash in excess of INR21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter, well managed and providing sufficient fuel for future growth investments, strategic opportunities and improved shareholder returns.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the business faced RM inflation, supply chain and logistics disruptions, and a ransomware attack during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: It was a tough quarter with RM inflation, supply chain and logistics disruptions as well as a ransomware attack, which you may have read about, but it was defended comprehensively and successfully.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to accomplish an exhaustive portfolio makeover in the 125cc segment within the next 6 weeks.
management_commitments.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets moving exports to beyond the 250,000 per month level starting from the current quarter and onwards.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, the exports business, which like I said is 40% of our revenue, has established an outstanding growth momentum and we are looking at moving exports to beyond the 2,50,000 per month level this quarter and onwards.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to introduce 2 new brands in the 125cc segment later in the year to cover full customer spectrums.
management_commitments.quote: Further, in the year, we aim to introduce 2 new brands in the 125cc segment to cover the full spectrum of customers in this large segment as well as proposition customers from the 100cc segment to upgrade.
